import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_BOARD_DIM = 11;
    static final int MAX_VERTEX_COUNT = 1000;
    static final int MAX_EDGE_COUNT = 100100;
    static final int LARGE_VALUE = (1 << 29);

    static class Edge {
        int dest, cur_flow, cap, next;
        Edge(int dest, int cur_flow, int cap, int next) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.cur_flow = cur_flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] graph_edge = new Edge[2 * MAX_EDGE_COUNT];
    static int[] first_edge = new int[MAX_VERTEX_COUNT];
    static int[] ptr_level = new int[MAX_VERTEX_COUNT];
    static int[] level_arr = new int[MAX_VERTEX_COUNT];
    static int[] bfs_list = new int[MAX_VERTEX_COUNT];
    static int total_edges, total_nodes, start_node, end_node, queue_end, queue_start;

    static void setup_flow(int node_cnt, int src, int dst) {
        total_nodes = node_cnt;
        start_node = src;
        end_node = dst;
        total_edges = 2;
        Arrays.fill(first_edge, 0, total_nodes + 1, 0);
    }

    static void add_connection(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph_edge[total_edges] = new Edge(v, 0, cap, first_edge[u]);
        first_edge[u] = total_edges++;
        graph_edge[total_edges] = new Edge(u, 0, 0, first_edge[v]);
        first_edge[v] = total_edges++;
    }

    static boolean create_levels() {
        Arrays.fill(level_arr, 0, total_nodes + 1, 0);
        queue_end = queue_start = 0;
        bfs_list[queue_end++] = start_node;
        level_arr[start_node] = 1;
        while (queue_start < queue_end && level_arr[end_node] == 0) {
            int u = bfs_list[queue_start++];
            for (int e = first_edge[u]; e != 0; e = graph_edge[e].next) {
                int v = graph_edge[e].dest;
                if (level_arr[v] == 0 && graph_edge[e].cur_flow < graph_edge[e].cap) {
                    level_arr[v] = level_arr[u] + 1;
                    bfs_list[queue_end++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return level_arr[end_node] != 0;
    }

    static int augment_path(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (u == end_node) return bottleneck;
        for (int e = ptr_level[u]; e != 0; e = ptr_level[u] = graph_edge[e].next) {
            int v = graph_edge[e].dest;
            if (level_arr[u] < level_arr[v] && graph_edge[e].cur_flow < graph_edge[e].cap &&
                (bottleneck = augment_path(v, Math.min(bottleneck, graph_edge[e].cap - graph_edge[e].cur_flow))) != 0) {
                graph_edge[e].cur_flow += bottleneck;
                graph_edge[e ^ 1].cur_flow -= bottleneck;
                return bottleneck;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_max_flow() {
        int result = 0, delta;
        while (create_levels()) {
            System.arraycopy(first_edge, 0, ptr_level, 0, total_nodes + 1);
            while ((delta = augment_path(start_node, LARGE_VALUE)) != 0) {
                result += delta;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int size_grid;
    static String[] grid_A = new String[MAX_BOARD_DIM];
    static String[] grid_B = new String[MAX_BOARD_DIM];

    static int[] dr = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] dc = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean valid_cell(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < size_grid && c < size_grid && 
               grid_A[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && grid_A[r].charAt(c) != 'Z';
    }

    static int[][][] time_stamps = new int[2][MAX_BOARD_DIM][MAX_BOARD_DIM];

    static void expand_bfs(int start_r, int start_c, int idx) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BOARD_DIM; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_BOARD_DIM; j++) {
                time_stamps[idx][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        time_stamps[idx][start_r][start_c] = 1;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{start_r, start_c});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            if (idx == 1 && time_stamps[0][r][c] != 0 && time_stamps[0][r][c] <= time_stamps[1][r][c]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (valid_cell(nr, nc) && time_stamps[idx][nr][nc] == 0) {
                    time_stamps[idx][nr][nc] = time_stamps[idx][r][c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] node_id = new int[2][MAX_BOARD_DIM][MAX_BOARD_DIM];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        size_grid = sc.nextInt();
        int limit_T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int pos_Zr = 0, pos_Zc = 0;
        int total_node_num = 0, source_v = 0, sink_v = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < size_grid; ++r) {
            grid_A[r] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int c = 0; c < size_grid; ++c) {
                if (grid_A[r].charAt(c) == 'Z') {
                    pos_Zr = r;
                    pos_Zc = c;
                } else if (grid_A[r].charAt(c) != 'Y') {
                    total_node_num++;
                    node_id[0][r][c] = total_node_num;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int r = 0; r < size_grid; ++r) {
            grid_B[r] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int c = 0; c < size_grid; ++c) {
                if (grid_B[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && grid_B[r].charAt(c) != 'Z') {
                    total_node_num++;
                    node_id[1][r][c] = total_node_num;
                }
            }
        }

        total_node_num++;
        source_v = 0;
        sink_v = total_node_num;
        setup_flow(total_node_num, source_v, sink_v);

        for (int r = 0; r < size_grid; ++r) {
            for (int c = 0; c < size_grid; ++c) {
                if (grid_A[r].charAt(c) != 'Z' && grid_A[r].charAt(c) != 'Y') {
                    add_connection(source_v, node_id[0][r][c], grid_A[r].charAt(c) - '0');
                    add_connection(node_id[1][r][c], sink_v, grid_B[r].charAt(c) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        expand_bfs(pos_Zr, pos_Zc, 0);

        for (int r = 0; r < size_grid; ++r) {
            for (int c = 0; c < size_grid; ++c) {
                if (grid_A[r].charAt(c) > '0' && grid_A[r].charAt(c) <= '9') {
                    expand_bfs(r, c, 1);
                    for (int rr = 0; rr < size_grid; ++rr) {
                        for (int cc = 0; cc < size_grid; ++cc) {
                            if (grid_B[rr].charAt(cc) > '0' && grid_B[rr].charAt(cc) <= '9') {
                                if (time_stamps[1][rr][cc] != 0 && 
                                    (time_stamps[0][rr][cc] == 0 || time_stamps[0][rr][cc] >= time_stamps[1][rr][cc]) &&
                                    time_stamps[1][rr][cc] - 1 <= limit_T) {
                                    add_connection(node_id[0][r][c], node_id[1][rr][cc], LARGE_VALUE);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute_max_flow());
    }
}
